docs.title: Welcome!
docs.text:
Welcome to my blog!

This blog is a personal knowledge base built from hands-on experience and studies across platforms like Hack The Box (HTB) and SANS GIAC.

As I learn new concepts and techniques, I will try my best to outline them here and make them as intuitive as possible.

docs.title: SQL Injection
docs.text: A flaw in how user data is interpreted in SQL (database) queries where maliciously constructed input leads to unintended, often harmful actions. Examples include retrieving data not normally retrievable, such as sensitive data or data belong to other people, or modifying or deleting data.
